prompts.label: 01 — MARK III CHEST
prompts.description: Design direction: 2008 Iron Man Mark III CHEST ARMOR only. Strong recognizable red pectoral plates, short angular shoulder caps with restrained gold side armor, shallow recessed collar (NO neck stalk), torso gently tapering toward the waist. The central display is incorporated INSIDE a clean circular arc-reactor bezel: icy-blue ring, charcoal interior and the rectangular black display fully visible inside it. The reactor housing must fit all corners of the rectangular screen and form the main focal point. Chest surface sculpting and shoulder proportions make this unmistakably Iron Man armor rather than a generic tag. No eyes, helmet or face features anywhere. Simple premium design, restrained gold, integrated shoulders rather than separate arms.
prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create ONE premium industrial-design concept illustration of an Iron Man themed Christmas ornament enclosure with an integrated small electronic display. This is a new visual exploration, NOT a rendering of existing CAD.
Square composition on a warm off-white studio background. One object only, centered with generous margins, almost straight-on front view, very slightly elevated to reveal a modest 20–25 mm edge thickness. Entire hanging loop and bottom visible. Crisp, polished but restrained product design, attractive shallow faceted armor surfaces, clean broad color areas suitable for later multicolor 3D printing. Satin dark crimson red, warm gold, dark charcoal and luminous-looking icy cyan as the FOUR surface colors. Soft studio light. Restrained details, neither a toy face nor excessive sci-fi greebles.
MANDATORY: one clearly visible, fully unobstructed black rectangular display window, approximately 28.6 mm wide by 31.6 mm tall, slightly taller than wide with small corner radii. Keep it realistically proportioned relative to an approximately 75–100 mm ornament. No screen graphics, lettering or second black screen. Screen location must be deliberate and physically plausible for a single common electronics core behind it. Small sturdy centered suspension eyelet integrated into the top. No head with a huge rectangular mouth, no exposed human face, no raised hollow neck, no neck-shaped opening, no cables, no Christmas decorations or tree scene, no hand holding it, no manufacturing diagrams or dimensions. Render a plausible designed object, not a flat generic icon. Do not add extra objects.
Add only the exact short concept label specified below in small neat dark typography beneath the object.

prompts.label: 02 — TRAPEZOID ARMOR
prompts.description: Design direction: an angular Iron Man upper torso with a broad-top, narrow-bottom TRAPEZOID arc-reactor bezel around the central black rectangular display. The frame is physically generous enough to enclose the entire rectangle. Crisp layered crimson pectoral armor, chamfered straight shoulder caps, small warm-gold bicep panels flanking the display, red forearm-like side panels integrated into one sturdy silhouette. Compact top edge with a shallow collar cut, NOT a raised neck. Keep the lower center below the display plain red. Thin icy-blue trapezoid border makes a luminous reactor impression without overpowering the red armor. No eyes, no helmet, no human-face suggestions. Distinct architectural geometry and controlled bevels.

prompts.label: 03 — HELMET BADGE
prompts.description: Design direction: a carefully composed red-and-charcoal shield-shaped pendant incorporating a COMPLETE recognizable flat gold Iron Man helmet emblem above the black display. The helmet is a stylized official-merch-quality closed armor mask with tall red forehead notch, narrow icy cyan lenses, angular cheek plates and a simple mechanical chin; no human nose, drawn facial wrinkles, or expressive lips. The entire mask stays intact ABOVE the screen. The display sits neatly in the lower half of the same unified shield silhouette. Balance the complete small helmet and screen as two stacked elements, not a lollipop perched on a long rectangle. Thin red rim, charcoal face field, gold helmet, cyan eyes. Minimal badges/pins aesthetic with shallow relief; no extra chest or arm details.

prompts.label: 04 — REPULSOR GAUNTLET
prompts.description: Design direction: recognizable Iron Man red-and-gold REPULSOR HAND / GAUNTLET, palm facing forward, stylized as a compact Christmas ornament. Five short armored finger silhouettes form the upper outline and thumb side; use chunky connected simplified fingers rather than spindly separated digits. Palm contains the black rectangular display, fully unobstructed, centered within a circular icy-blue repulsor ring with a dark charcoal surround. Gold knuckle and finger armor accents, crimson palm and short crimson cuff below. Overall strong compact hand silhouette, suitable to later become one sturdy printed enclosure. Centered top suspension loop above the middle finger. No faces or helmets, no text on the hand, no long human arm. Make this a polished superhero product concept, not a realistic human hand.

prompts.label: 05 — REACTOR MEDALLION
prompts.description: Design direction: an elegant circular Iron Man ARC REACTOR MEDALLION ornament, with a small flat bottom for the core to slide in. Thick crimson outer armor ring, recessed dark charcoal inner disk, six to eight broad gold radial reactor segments and an icy cyan inner luminous-looking circular ring. Central display remains a black rectangle slightly taller than wide, entirely visible INSIDE the circular aperture. Gold radial segments sit outside the blue ring and must not cross the display. Industrial reactor-inspired jewelry / collectible design, not a clock face or steering wheel. Crisp concentric tiers and shallow bevels, no screws or excessive tiny greebles. No shoulders, helmet, human face or arms. The screen and a small top hanging loop are integrated gracefully into the medallion. This should have an unmistakably different circular silhouette from either chest concept.
